model.acceptance: suitable microscopic connectivity, closed boundary, exactly one component, ambient-isotopic to the unknot

claims.statement: The seed-only language BKW11_U with accepting area at most max(1,|dom(s)|)^2 is NP-complete.
The direct compiler's microscopic fillings are bijective with directed cycle covers, and mosaic components are bijective with cover cycles.
A frozen one-cell tile-0 moat makes every accepting completion on every larger rectangle blank outside the compiled core.
Crossing-blocked exact-core raw counting is #P-complete under parsimonious reductions.
Existentially unbounded raw seed completion is NP-hard and recursively enumerable.
No NP upper bound is claimed for arbitrary existentially unbounded seeds.
The unbounded fragment whose seeds freeze only tiles 0 through 8 is decidable and has a computable accepting-witness bound.
Relative signed-tangle unknot completion is recursively enumerable for every finite string number and decidable for one, two, and three strings.
Decide relative signed-tangle unknot completion, equivalently prescribed-involution S^3-embeddability, for arbitrary string number at least four.
Prove or refute r.e.-hardness or r.e.-completeness of unrestricted unbounded raw standard-eleven seed completion.
The original protected-factor PF-3SAT atom/parser/copy architecture is unnecessary for bounded raw NP-hardness, but its literal open lemmas were not retroactively declared proved.
The completion validator passes normally and under Python optimization: 33 claims, five former-open crosswalk entries, and six byte-identical reproduced result files.
